library_layout.note: This repo is a distribution library, not a runnable monorepo runtime.

claude_code.skill_invoke: Skill name after install under .claude/skills/{name}/SKILL.md — agent may load via skill tool or user types the skill name.
claude_code.agent: @agent-name only if your harness maps @ to agent files; otherwise open agents/*.md path.
claude_code.task: *command when the agent definition exposes commands; otherwise describe the task by name from tasks/.
claude_code.slash_pack: /Prefix:... only if the project registered the pack; never invent.

codex.skill_invoke: Project/global skills by name if configured; else attach SKILL.md content.
codex.agent: Instruct model to adopt persona from squads/{id}/agents/{entry}.md
codex.task: Reference task file path; do not assume * prefix.

generic.agent: System prompt: adopt entry agent file
generic.task: Natural language task name from tasks/

routing_procedure: 1. Classify user intent (decide / research / reverse-engineer / build / sell / operate).
2. Match intents[] and avoid_when in this manifest; if tie, open Mapa-de-decisao.md.
3. Open the lesson file for the chosen squad.
4. If squad not installed in the active project, follow if_not_installed before executing.
5. Build briefing from the lesson template; confirm external side effects.
7. Require evidence checklist before claiming done.
